acceptance_criteria.requirement: The authorized Stage 3 main commit, tree, continuation identities, and repository isolation are independently verified before Stage 4 work.
All Stage 0 through Stage 3 validators and deterministic proofs remain reproducible before and after Stage 4.
Versioned online record, plan, validation, activation, pointer, and serving contracts freeze canonical identities and typed values.
Entity-generation keys, access paths, pagination, and the candidate lifecycle are explicit and never infer active state from recency.
Invalid values, unsupported transitions, identity reuse, corrupt state, and cross-service atomicity assumptions fail closed with typed outcomes.
Pinned AWS SDK dependencies validate low-level DynamoDB item, query, candidate-control, conditional-write, and activation-transaction request shapes without runtime access.
A file-backed SQLite adapter proves the declared observable semantics across pagination, restart, and independent concurrent connections.
Each deterministic materialization plan binds one verified offline generation, definition set, source identity, expected key set, count, and aggregate digest.
Candidate writes are generation-isolated, conditionally idempotent, persistent, and reject conflicting operation or record identity reuse.
Restart resumes only missing work and exact keyset reconciliation verifies count, uniqueness, content digests, and the ordered aggregate before issuing a receipt.
Partial, extra, duplicate, corrupt, tampered, or mismatched candidates cannot become VALIDATED or ACTIVE.
Activation binds the candidate to its exact validation receipt, expected generation, expected pointer version, and immutable operation identity.
Pointer activation is compare-and-swap guarded; stale or failed publication preserves the prior active generation.
Two real local publishers racing from the same pointer yield exactly one commit and one semantic conflict.
A lost activation acknowledgement survives process restart and exact replay returns the original receipt without another pointer event.
A reader pins one generation for its request; pointer changes cannot mix generations and retained historical generations remain explicit.
TTL is an asynchronous cleanup hint while serving eligibility is checked synchronously with exact controlled-clock expiry and freshness boundaries.
Serving distinguishes FOUND, ABSENT, EXPIRED, STALE, DEFINITION_MISMATCH, GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE, CORRUPT_RECORD, and STORAGE_FAILURE.
Online expiry or retirement never mutates immutable offline generations or changes historical reconstruction.
Bounded seeded retries, durable attempt records, partial progress, duplicate dispatch, timeout, corruption, exhaustion, and recovery produce deterministic isolated outcomes.
Deterministic capacity evidence reports item bytes, service-limit headroom, request counts, entity concentration, and reconciliation work for bounded profiles.
Capacity conclusions state assumptions, redesign thresholds, and explicit non-claims for live AWS performance, cost, scaling, and availability.
Lint, strict typing, dependency integrity, complete tests and coverage, validators, contamination checks, and byte-identical Stage 4 proof regeneration pass.
The unchanged reviewed head and base satisfy required CI and review gates; merged main is independently reproduced and bound by a continuation receipt.
